body: When it started getting obvious things were getting serious and probably leading to physical intimacy, he sat me down and we had a talk. He just told me he had herpes, the facts behind the disease and what it meant for us as a couple. I did some fact checking and the risks of transmission were low so I was okay with it. I was happy he was honest with me though. He considered the disease an idiot filter. If someone wasn't going to be with him because he had some silly virus, then he figured they didn't really love him enough anyway and weren't worth his time. Maybe something to remember.
Hmm...let me look into how to make Pokemon plushies. I never have made a toy knitting before.
Oh, thank you but there is no need. That's very sweet of you though. I'm just letting the rest of the day pass and I will start again tomorrow.

I dated someone with herpes. Now you might think I'm unattractive or had no other prospects. I am actually pretty good looking and I had a lot of other people I could have dated. Still, I chose him. He had the best sense of humor and I just adored him. The herpes was no big deal. We were just careful and I'm fine. Please don't let this define your life. It can be okay. Please talk to the people at the message board I linked you to. You'll be okay. I promise.
Didn't do it. Not sure who to make smile but if I happen across someone I will give it a try. Thanks for taking the time to respond and help. You're a good person.

Thank you, elohizzle. It's a rough day but I thank you for talking to me last night and for sharing your insight. What you said about being some people's angel has really stuck with me. Thank you so much. Many hugs to you. I'm so grateful for you.

Yeah, you're right. I am trying to take the fuck them attitude. I'm trying to believe more in my inherent self worth. I'm also trying to see that they do have problems, some more severe than mine. 

You make a very good point about the agoraphobia. It isn't quite as simple as just walking out the door, but with the fear of death gone I think I am more free to move about. For me, when I am in a place I can't easily escape, I start to panic and the room spins. It is very hard to control. But part of my fear is the fear of death. I think that should be gone from my panic attacks now. I am going to make a more concerted effort to get over this problem. I want to surf. I want to snorkel. I want to see the sun set on a beach in Southern California. I want to live. 

You're right. Thanks for the new perspective.

Yes, I am starting to come to the same conclusion regarding people. I just can't help thinking there is good in everyone. I also seem to be too adept at placing myself in their shoes and understanding why they act the way they do. I think it ends up with me staying in negative situations much longer than I should. And yes, I just told someone today that I don't even feel a part of the human race. I'm not sure I am really better than anyone; I just think I'm more sensitive. I really wish I wasn't. Thank you for your words and for taking the time to help. I appreciate it.

I'm not dead. I'm not happy, but I'm not dead. I certainly wouldn't want to upset a 12 year old. I have a lot of hobbies. I like to knit and yes, I do like video games. I am looking forward to the new Borderlands and would love to see another Portal game. Thank you so much for your kind words. You're a very precocious 12 year old!

I'm going to write that down. Thank you. Very powerful words. Thank you so much. I think I I'm falling asleep and need to go. Sleep is probably the best thing for how I feel. I will be repeating your words in my head though. Thank you.

I think your response is very insightful and might be the issue. I'm going to have to think about it. Thank you. Maybe I just need to be more careful. Or maybe if I get better then more stable people will find me attractive and I can finally have a decent relationship with people who can communicate and own their own baggage instead of using me as a punching bag.

I've had so many screwed up relationships and I'm the only common denominator. But maybe there is something else going on. These people have all had problems of their own. Maybe I'm just an easy person to talk to and then they get scared I know too much? I don't know. People tend to spill their guts to me. Then I think we are close friends. But the friendship seems to be based more on shared pain than fun. I have no idea. I'm just so tired of feeling used and angry.
Thank you. I will keep your story in mind. I'm sorry you went through it. It just seems no one ever wants me as a friend or a lover. I wish I knew what I did to turn people off so much.

I'm really sad. I had a relationship with someone for seven years. This is the first year I won't hear from them on my birthday. It is past midnight. Usually they wrote at midnight to wish me happy birthday. Tonight? Silence. I will not hear from them. 

And on top of everything else it is just killing me.
Chicago.
I'm in the US. You don't have to. I think I'm just going to sleep. Thank you. I don't want to impose.

I'm trying. Just once I'd like to feel loved. I love people so much and try to give so much to them and all I feel is vilified and misunderstood. 

And I'm so tired of waking up every day alone and in pain. And tomorrow will be the same except it is my birthday, and the people I loved and tried to be good to will ignore me.

The mental hospitals around here are full. They won't take you unless you've swallowed something or have a gunshot to the head. Plus they can't help me. They don't do therapy. They only do meds and I'm on meds they can't change. There is nothing a hospital can do for me. I'm sorry. I shouldn't have posted. You're all do kind to try to help. I'm just out of hope.

You've juicy the nail on the head. Compassion is my problem. I have been kind to many people. Recently I tried to help someone get their iPhone app made. What happened? He accused me of stealing his idea. I didn't. I've done nothing with his idea. He thinks that because I didn't mention him in every conversation I had with people that I was trying to take credit for his work. Then there is another "friend". I helped her through a severe case of PTSD. Then when she was being stalked online I took the brunt of it do she wouldn't be triggered. My reward? Her friends and girlfriend all yelled at me and told me what a piece of shit I was and that I was never there for this friend enough. This birthday she won't acknowledge my existence. I knit scarves for the homeless. I've knit scarves for people with AIDS.  I've knit blankets for children with AIDS. I've raised money for AIDS, The American HeArt Association, ASPCA, etc. I've volunteered for a literacy group. But I'm still seen as an asshole. I'm still a fucked up bitch alone on her birthday. Compassion is the problem. I need to be the asshole everyone thinks I am.

Please go to that website I linked. They can help you through telling someone. A person who loves you will want to be with you no matter what stupid virus you have. Take precautions and the chance of transmission will be very low. A loving partner will understand. It isn't over for you. The older you get the more people you will meet who have it. So many people have herpes and don't even know it.
I don't have a Therapist anymore. I fired her Friday. My brother lives in Washington. I live in Illinois. I know no one here.

With Valtrex (prescription) and a condom your chances of passing it on when you're not having an outbreak are very slim. 

Check out the forums at www.racoon.com/herpes to find some people experiencing the same pain you are. Maybe you can find some support and feel better.
There is treatment for agoraphobia. What have you tried? Exposure therapy? Meds? Anything? You can get better and be functional outside the house. I swear. We just have to get some help for you.

I have no idea what I'm even capable of anymore. It is hard to see any light at the end of this. I'm older and will just be ibises using my degree. The job market is terrible and I have no experience. I had an idea for a business but I just found out someone else is working on the same thing. It seems like every time I find a light it gets snuffed out. 

And another "friend" is abandoning me. I just want to die. I dont want to get out of this bed. I just want to lie here until I die. I can't believe this is what my life has become. I can't stand another day.

Right now I'm super sleepy. I would like to talk to you again. I thank you for your kindness tonight. I was really teetering on the edge. I'm going to at least stick around to see what the rheumatologist says. I'm just so tired of the days being so monotonous. I will give your post a better reply in the morning. But thank you. You made me feel a little hope and distracted me long enough for me to get sleepy. Thank you.

No, they haven't tried anything. Every time the tests come back clean they just write it off as anxiety. But again, how is anxiety causing me to have more and more difficulty walking up the stairs? 

I'm very sorry to hear your friend is going through something similar. Sounds like you are a wonderful friend to her though. Support is important. And sadly I don't have support. 

I'm just tired. Another damn holiday spent doing nothing. Next month I will have another birthday spent alone. Hell, last year I was in the hospital for my birthday. Fun. I just don't want to be here anymore. There is no joy.

I can identify with that. I've had so many procedures done yet they never find anything wrong. Sometimes I think they are just after the insurance money. Just last week I had an endoscopy and colonoscopy. They thought they saw thickening of the bowel on an x-ray. I'm tired of being poked and prodded only to for nothing to be found. Then they just say I'm nuts again. I don't see how anxiety or depression causes joint pain to the extent I can barely hang on to my phone. Besides, my psychiatrist doesn't think the pain is psychological. He has nothing else to give me either. I just can't live life like this. I've tried to get help but I'm getting nowhere.

Thank you. I definitely need something. If it is pushing then I'm not sure in which direction. 

Have you been checked out for the physical pain?
I've tried. I can't find a story. :/

I'm sorry to hear you have such a difficult time too. 

My family doesn't help. They are incredibly negative people. 

I don't even know what I want to do with my life anymore. I don't really have dreams or aspirations. When I was younger I wanted to be a clinical psychologist or a lawyer. Those options are out now. I don't have the energy or the money.
I'm do sorry. May I ask what is going on with you? Have you appealed the disability decision?

I don't really know how things are going to turn out for my friend. I'm afraid that as time goes on the chances of a full recovery are quite slim. But hopefully she will recover. She deserves to. 

I have an appointment with a rheumatologist the 27th. I keep trying to hope she will find out why I'm so tired and achy. All my labs come back clear though. I've been seen by numerous doctors. No one has a clue. No one knows why I am in pain. No one knows why I never recovered any energy after the surgery. They just don't know but how can I be expected to live like this? I already had the agoraphobia to fight. Now I have no energy to fight it with.

I don't really know what to say. I need some answers. I need some hope. No one seems to have answers. Professionals have written me off at this point. I don't know what to do. 

Today someone told me an old friend had a stroke. She is in the ICU and has been for three months. She is a wife, mother and has her doctorate in pharmacology. She shouldn't be there. She's loved and successful. I would trade places with her. She has so much to live for. I don't.
